topic: Clarified first-field Care pressure and gated Cultivation behind Expanding Field
currentUserGoal: Make the first-run Care panel understandable and prevent any field Cultivation or expansion control from appearing or working before the relevant Expanding Field Memory is owned.
workCompleted: Renamed the first-run Care Balance panel to Scourge vs Care.
Rewrote the panel to explain Scourge HP drain, helper Care, net drain, immediate manual healing, later steady Care, and the permanent reward from the first collapse.
Carried the Care-versus-Scourge comparison into the later Living Ledger status line.
Added a shared hasUnlockedFieldExpansion rule to the headless economy model.
Blocked Cultivation purchases at the model layer unless the next field-size Memory is owned.
Removed the Cultivation label and button from the Phaser field UI until that Memory is owned.
Removed the Cultivation control and progress text from the accessible DOM until that Memory is owned.
Normalized contradictory old active saves back to zero Cultivation when no next-field Memory is owned.
Improved the accessible Expanding Field Memory label, cost, and disabled state.
Corrected the accessible equipment message shown while a later field is in Memory Grove.
verificationRun: Focused Ecosystem System and Save tests passed: 65 tests.
npm run check passed: ESLint, 207 Vitest tests across 24 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
A clean Run 1 showed the revised Scourge vs Care lesson without overlap.
A clean Run 2 without Expanding Field showed no Cultivation label, visible button, or accessible control.
After remembering Expanding Field, Cultivation progress and the Growth purchase control appeared.
The browser reported no warnings or errors.
knownIssues: The large Scourge vs Care lesson is desktop-only; mobile retains the compact top pressure readout.
The Expanding Field Memory cost curve may still need hands-on progression tuning.
The unrelated docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md remains untracked and is not part of this slice.
nextRecommendedSteps: Hands-on test the first three runs and verify the new pressure explanation feels useful instead of tutorial-heavy.
Judge whether Expanding Field should remain on the first post-Sprinkler frontier or reveal after one additional Memory.
Continue the contextual Field Notes onboarding slice for first automation, first Growth, and first equipment purchase.
doNotRevert: Do not show or enable Cultivation when state.field.sizeIndex is not below permanent.maxFieldTier.
Do not preserve hidden Cultivation progress from saves that do not own the next field-size Memory.
Do not restore the ambiguous Care Balance copy that omitted the relationship between manual healing and helper Care.
Do not include docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md without explicit user direction.
